description: reimport and set_options import every file that is behind, not only resourcePath. An open editor scans the project first. Operations: status: which resources are outdated or failed, and why; options (needs resourcePath): the import options of one resource; set_options (needs resourcePath): change import options or the importer, then reimport; reimport: what status says is outdated or failed, or resourcePath; uid (needs resourcePath): the UID of one file, or null; refresh_uids: give every script and shader a .uid sidecar and fill the uid cache; refresh_classes: rewrite the class list from the class_name declarations on disk.

force.description: Reimport even what is current. Default false. For op reimport.

importer.description: The importer to switch to, such as image. The file's options go back to its defaults first. For op set_options.

includeUpToDate.description: List resources that are current as well. Default false. For op status.

options.description: Import options keyed as the .import file spells them, {"compress/mode": 1}. Number keys are digit strings, and opentype_features also takes a tag: {"opentype_features": {"liga": 0}}. For op set_options.

reimport.description: Reimport afterwards. Default true. For op set_options.

resourcePath.description: File inside the project, such as "sprites/hero.png" or "materials/steel.tres". Not for ops refresh_uids, refresh_classes.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the editor to finish reimporting. Default 300000. For ops reimport, set_options.

name: project_import
title: Asset imports
